method.paired_order: baseline first on even zero-based scenario index; candidate first on odd
method.cache_policy: separate XDG_CACHE_HOME per binary to avoid pipeline cache eviction
method.gpu_runs: sequential; no browser or build/test concurrently
method.statistic: sorted element floor(n/2) for median and min(n-1, floor(0.95*n)) for p95, matching existing runner
method.p95_limitation: With n=12, p95 is the maximum observation; not a reliable population-tail estimate
method.cpu_time_scope: elapsed main-thread edit phases including blocking waits; candidate enqueue plus all submit/finish phases; NOT CPU core utilization or complete frame time
method.latency_scope: accepted to live publication, NOT input to displayed pixels
method.repeat_scope: five targeted scenarios, not a second complete suite

limitations: Controlled deterministic flat-terrain fixture, not continuous manual interaction.
No measured end-to-end input-to-present latency, whole-frame tail latency or memory peak.
One current Linux GPU; historical Mac data is from different commits and baseline.
Some synchronous controls also vary; percentages are local observations, not universal regressions.
Full all-target Linux builds have a pre-existing collision_bench_rapier.rs std::fs import error; both application Release binaries build.

report.scope: production edit call; excludes input pick, fixture reset, validation and future frames
